name: Grosseto (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Grosseto (a white griffin holding a sword on red).
history: Municipal flag of Grosseto, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Grosseto arms — white griffin holding a sword on red, crowned
